docs.title: DeadChest - Commands & Permissions
docs.text:
Make sure you have installed the plugin before reading this section.

This page documents the current /dc commands and permission nodes.

For Pro's /dc menu, /dc track, /dc teleport, /dc history and /dc restore, see Pro commands and permissions.

docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
Command Permission Description /dc reload deadchest.admin Reload configuration and localization. /dc repair deadchest.admin Remove nearby broken legacy/DeadChest holograms around the executing player. /dc repair force deadchest.admin Force-remove nearby armor stand holograms around the executing player. /dc remove deadchest.remove.own Remove all of your own DeadChests. /dc remove <player> deadchest.remove.other Remove all DeadChests belonging to a specific player. /dc removeinfinite deadchest.admin Remove all infinite DeadChests. /dc removeall deadchest.admin Remove all DeadChests globally. /dc list deadchest.list.own* List your own DeadChests. /dc list <player> deadchest.list.other List DeadChests for a specific player. /dc list all deadchest.list.other List all DeadChests on the server. /dc giveback <player> deadchest.giveback Give back the latest active DeadChest inventory to a player. /dc giveback <player> latest deadchest.giveback Give back the latest active DeadChest for a player. /dc giveback <player> oldest deadchest.giveback Give back the oldest active DeadChest for a player. /dc giveback <player> all deadchest.giveback Give back all active DeadChests for a player. /dc giveback <player> id <n> deadchest.giveback Give back one specific active DeadChest by list id. /dc giveback <player> <selector> inventory deadchest.giveback Restore through the player's inventory, then drop overflow. /dc giveback <player> <selector> ground deadchest.giveback Drop restored items at the player's location. /dc giveback list <player> deadchest.giveback List active DeadChests for a player with selectable ids. /dc giveback preview <player> deadchest.giveback Preview the default giveback action for a player without applying it. /dc giveback preview <player> <selector> deadchest.giveback Preview a selected giveback target without applying it. /dc giveback preview <player> <selector> <strategy> deadchest.giveback Preview a giveback with explicit strategy without applying it. /dc giveback preview list <player> deadchest.giveback Preview the selectable giveback list for a player. /dc config deadchest.config Show /dc config usage. deadchest.admin also bypasses this permission. /dc config get <path> deadchest.config Read a config value using its canonical YAML path. /dc config set <path> <value> deadchest.config Update a config value using its canonical YAML path. /dc config reset <path> deadchest.config Reset a config value to its default. /dc config edit <path> deadchest.config Open an interactive editor for supported paths (filters.ignored-items only, player-only). /dc ignore deadchest.admin Deprecated alias for /dc config edit filters.ignored-items.

* deadchest.list.own is only required when permissions.require-list-own: true in config.yml.

/dc giveback selectors are deterministic:

  • default /dc giveback <player> behaves like latest
  • oldest selects the oldest active chest by creation date
  • latest selects the newest active chest by creation date
  • all restores every active chest for the player
  • id <n> uses the ids shown by /dc giveback list <player>
  • optional strategy inventory restores to inventory then drops overflow
  • optional strategy ground drops items at the target player's location

Current behavior notes:

  • if the target is offline, the selected giveback is queued and delivered automatically on next login
  • queued deliveries are persisted in the SQLite pending_givebacks table
  • inventory gives XP directly and restores items to inventory before dropping overflow
  • ground drops items at the target player's location and gives XP directly
  • preview never modifies chests, storage, inventory, or the offline queue
  • id values are runtime list ids, not persistent database ids

docs.title: Permission Nodes
docs.text: Permission Description deadchest.admin Access admin commands and bypass deadchest.config. deadchest.config Access /dc config get|set|reset|edit. deadchest.generate Generate a DeadChest on death (if required by config). deadchest.get Claim/retrieve a DeadChest (if required by config). deadchest.chestPass Bypass owner-only chest access. deadchest.infinityChest Create infinite DeadChests. deadchest.remove.own Remove own DeadChests with /dc remove. deadchest.remove.other Remove another player's DeadChests with /dc remove <player>. deadchest.list.own List own DeadChests with /dc list (if required by config). deadchest.list.other List another player's/all DeadChests with /dc list <player> or /dc list all. deadchest.giveback Give back another player's items with /dc giveback <player>.

docs.title: Config-Dependent Permission Requirements
docs.text:
The following config flags control whether some actions require permissions:

  • permissions.require-generate: require deadchest.generate for chest generation.
  • permissions.require-claim: require deadchest.get for claiming chests.
  • permissions.require-list-own: require deadchest.list.own for /dc list.

/dc config uses canonical YAML paths, so command input stays aligned with config.yml:

  • Example: /dc config get localization.language
  • Example: /dc config set chest.block-type barrel
  • Example: /dc config reset visuals.effect-animation.style
  • Example: /dc config edit filters.ignored-items

/dc ignore is still available for compatibility, but it is deprecated.

Console behavior:

  • /dc config, /dc config get, /dc config set, and /dc config reset can be executed from the server console.
  • /dc config edit and /dc ignore are player-only because they open a GUI.

/dc config edit filters.ignored-items and /dc ignore edit filters.ignored-items from config.yml directly:

  • filters.ignored-items ignores by Material name.
  • /dc config edit filters.ignored-items is the only currently supported interactive config editor and updates the same YAML list through a GUI.
  • /dc ignore points to that same editor for backward compatibility.
  • Custom items are stored there as serialized ItemStack entries, including item meta.
  • Ignored items are skipped by DeadChest storage and keep their default death behavior.

docs.title: DeadChest - Configuration
docs.text:
Make sure you have installed the plugin before editing the configuration.

For Pro's pro.yml, languages and feature permissions, see Pro configuration and permissions.

You can edit configuration directly in config.yml or in game with /dc config.

DeadChest now uses a structured config.yml (schema version 2) since v5.0.0. /dc config set and /dc config reset apply changes immediately. If you edit config.yml manually, run /dc reload.

Console behavior:

  • /dc config, /dc config get, /dc config set, and /dc config reset can be executed from the server console.
  • /dc config edit is player-only because it opens a GUI.

docs.title: Global
docs.text: Key Type Default Description config-version integer 2 Configuration schema version.

docs.title: Localization
docs.text: Key Type Default Description localization.language string en Language file loaded from plugins/DeadChest/localization/<language>.json (ex: en, fr, es, de, pt-br, pl, it, zh-cn).

docs.title: Updates
docs.text: Key Type Default Description updates.auto-check boolean true Enable automatic update checks at startup.

docs.title: Chest
docs.text: Key Type Default Description chest.owner-only-open boolean true During the private phase: only owner can open chest (except deadchest.chestPass). chest.duration-seconds integer 300 Duration of the private phase in seconds. 0 = infinite private phase. chest.indestructible boolean true Protect chest block from destruction/explosions. chest.max-per-player integer 15 Max active chests per player. 0 = unlimited. chest.recovery-mode string inventory-then-ground inventory-then-ground or ground-drop. chest.block-type string chest chest, player-head, barrel, shulker-box, ender-chest. chest.drop-items-on-timeout boolean false Legacy one-phase timeout behavior when chest.loot.enabled=false: drop items (true) or remove contents (false).

docs.title: Chest - Public Loot Phase
docs.text:
Key Type Default Description chest.loot.enabled boolean false Enable a second public loot phase after the private phase ends. chest.loot.public-duration-seconds integer 300 Duration of the public phase in seconds. 0 = infinite public phase. chest.loot.drop-items-on-timeout boolean false At the end of the public phase: drop items (true) or remove contents (false). chest.loot.public-access.owner boolean true During public phase, allow the owner to recover the chest. chest.loot.public-access.killer boolean true During public phase, allow the PvP killer to loot the chest. chest.loot.public-access.other-players boolean true During public phase, allow any other player to loot the chest.

The timeout model is therefore:

  • Phase 1: private phase controlled by chest.duration-seconds.
  • Phase 2: optional public phase controlled by chest.loot.*.
  • If chest.loot.enabled=false, the chest expires directly after the private phase and uses chest.drop-items-on-timeout.
  • If chest.loot.enabled=true, the chest enters the public phase after the private phase, then expires using chest.loot.drop-items-on-timeout.

docs.title: Permissions
docs.text: Key Type Default Description permissions.require-generate boolean false Require deadchest.generate to create chest on death. permissions.require-claim boolean false Require deadchest.get to claim/retrieve chest. permissions.require-list-own boolean false Require deadchest.list.own for /dc list.

docs.title: Maintenance
docs.text: Key Type Default Description maintenance.cleanup-on-startup boolean false Remove all DeadChests on server startup.

docs.title: Generation Rules
docs.text: Key Type Default Description generation.allow-in-creative boolean true Allow chest generation on death in Creative mode. generation.allow-on-lava boolean true Allow generation when death occurs in lava. generation.allow-on-water boolean true Allow generation when death occurs in water. generation.allow-on-rails boolean true Allow generation when death occurs on rails. generation.allow-in-minecart boolean true Allow generation when death occurs in minecart. generation.allow-in-end-worlds boolean true Allow generation in The End worlds.

docs.title: Messages
docs.text: Key Type Default Description messages.display-position-on-death boolean true Send chest coordinates to player on death.

docs.title: XP
docs.text: Key Type Default Description xp.store-on-death boolean false Store XP in chest instead of normal orb drop. xp.store-percentage integer 100 XP percent stored when enabled (0 to 100, values >100 duplicate XP).

docs.title: PvP
docs.text: Key Type Default Description pvp.keep-inventory-on-player-kill boolean false On PvP death: keep inventory and skip DeadChest generation.

docs.title: Integrations
docs.text: Key Type Default Description integrations.worldguard.enabled boolean false Enable WorldGuard region checks. integrations.worldguard.default-allow boolean false Default region policy if no DeadChest flag is set.

docs.title: Durability
docs.text: Key Type Default Description durability.loss-on-death-percent integer 0 Durability loss on death (percentage of max durability). 0 disables.

docs.title: Logging
docs.text: Key Type Default Description logging.deadchest-create-to-console boolean false Log each chest creation in console.

docs.title: Visuals - Effect Animation
docs.text:
Key Type Default Description visuals.effect-animation.enabled boolean true Enable orbit particles around active DeadChests. visuals.effect-animation.style string ender Effect style: soul, flame, ender. visuals.effect-animation.radius number 0.8 Orbit radius around chest center. visuals.effect-animation.speed number 1.1 Orbit speed multiplier.

DeadChest holograms now use three lines when available:

  • top line: access state (PRIVATE, OPEN, PUBLIC, KILLER, OWNER, SHARE)
  • middle line: owner name
  • bottom line: remaining time

The access-state line reflects both the private/public phase and the configured access rules during the public phase.

docs.title: Visuals - Pickup Animation
docs.text: Key Type Default Description visuals.pickup-animation.enabled boolean true Enable animation when a player claims a chest. visuals.pickup-animation.particle string FIREWORK Bukkit particle name used for pickup animation. visuals.pickup-animation.count integer 22 Number of particles spawned. visuals.pickup-animation.offset-x number 0.45 Particle spread on X axis. visuals.pickup-animation.offset-y number 0.5 Particle spread on Y axis. visuals.pickup-animation.offset-z number 0.45 Particle spread on Z axis. visuals.pickup-animation.speed number 0.08 Particle extra/speed value. visuals.pickup-animation.y-shift number 0.55 Vertical center offset from block base.

docs.title: Visuals - Pickup Sound
docs.text: Key Type Default Description visuals.sound.pickup.enabled boolean true Enable sound on chest pickup. visuals.sound.pickup.name string ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP Bukkit sound name. visuals.sound.pickup.volume number 1.2 Sound volume. visuals.sound.pickup.pitch number 1.0 Sound pitch.

docs.title: Filters
docs.text:
Key Type Default Description filters.excluded-worlds list Example values Worlds where DeadChest generation is disabled. filters.excluded-items list Example values Items that are not stored in DeadChest. filters.ignored-items list Example values Items ignored by DeadChest storage; they keep vanilla death behavior.

/dc config uses canonical YAML paths, so command usage stays aligned with this file:

  • /dc config get localization.language
  • /dc config set chest.duration-seconds 600
  • /dc config set filters.excluded-worlds world,world_nether
  • /dc config reset visuals.sound.pickup.name
  • /dc config edit filters.ignored-items

/dc config edit currently supports only filters.ignored-items.

filters.ignored-items, /dc config edit filters.ignored-items, and deprecated /dc ignore use the same source of truth:

  • filters.ignored-items is the canonical list in config.yml.
  • /dc config edit filters.ignored-items edits that same list through a GUI.
  • /dc ignore remains as a deprecated compatibility alias.
  • A rule can be either a Bukkit Material name or a serialized ItemStack.
  • Serialized ItemStack rules preserve custom meta and are written automatically by the interactive editor.
  • Ignored items are not saved in a DeadChest and are left to vanilla death handling or other plugins.

docs.title: Permission reference
docs.text:
• deadchest.admin: admin commands and bypass for /dc config
  • deadchest.config: use /dc config get|set|reset|edit
  • deadchest.generate: generate chest on death (if required)
  • deadchest.get: claim/retrieve chest (if required)
  • deadchest.list.own: list own chests (if required)
  • deadchest.list.other: list another player's chests
  • deadchest.remove.own: remove own chests
  • deadchest.remove.other: remove another player's chests
  • deadchest.giveback: give back another player's items
  • deadchest.chestPass: bypass owner-only chest access
  • deadchest.infinityChest: create infinite chests

docs.title: DeadChest - Customization
docs.text: This section explains how to customize DeadChest with the current configuration system.

docs.title: What can be customized
docs.text:
You can customize:

  • Language and messages (localization JSON files)
  • Visual effects around chests
  • Pickup animation particles
  • Pickup sound

Most visual/audio settings are in config.yml under visuals.*.

docs.title: Localization files
docs.text:
DeadChest uses JSON localization files located in:

plugins/DeadChest/localization/

Examples of bundled languages:

  • en.json
  • fr.json
  • es.json
  • de.json
  • pt-br.json
  • pl.json
  • it.json
  • zh-cn.json

Select active language in config.yml:

localization:
  language: en

docs.title: Placeholders in messages
docs.text:
Current placeholders use indexed format:

  • {0}
  • {1}
  • {2}

Example:

"commands.list.title.player": "DeadChests of {0}"

docs.title: Colors and formatting
docs.text:
Minecraft formatting codes are supported in localization strings.

  • Use § codes in text if needed.
  • Keep valid JSON syntax (quotes, commas, escaping).

docs.title: Legacy migration note
docs.text: If you used old locale.yml, DeadChest migrates it automatically to localization/en.json on startup and archives the legacy file.

docs.title: Visual customization (config.yml)
docs.text:
You can tune visuals in these sections:

  • visuals.effect-animation.*
  • visuals.pickup-animation.*
  • visuals.sound.pickup.*

Quick reference:

Key Description visuals.effect-animation.style Orbit style (soul, flame, ender). visuals.effect-animation.radius Orbit radius around chest. visuals.effect-animation.speed Orbit speed multiplier. visuals.pickup-animation.particle Particle used on pickup. visuals.pickup-animation.count Number of particles. visuals.sound.pickup.name Bukkit sound played on pickup. visuals.sound.pickup.volume Pickup sound volume. visuals.sound.pickup.pitch Pickup sound pitch.

For full option list, see configuration.

docs.title: Apply changes
docs.text:
• Run /dc reload after editing config.yml or localization files.
  • Validate server logs if a JSON formatting error occurs.

docs.title: DeadChest - How It Works
docs.text: This page explains how DeadChest behaves in common gameplay situations.

docs.title: Default behavior
docs.text:
When a player dies, DeadChest creates a protected chest at a suitable location near the death point. By default:

  • chest access starts in a private owner-only phase
  • a hologram shows access state, owner, and remaining time
  • the chest expires after configured timeout (unless infinite)

All behavior is configurable in configuration.

docs.title: Timeout model
docs.text:
DeadChest supports two phases:

  • Private phase: controlled by chest.duration-seconds
  • Public loot phase: optional, controlled by chest.loot.enabled and chest.loot.*

If the public loot phase is disabled, the chest expires directly after the private phase. If the public loot phase is enabled, the chest becomes public or semi-public after the private timer ends, depending on the configured public access rules.

docs.title: Hologram states
docs.text:
The top hologram line represents the current access state:

  • PRIVATE: owner-only private phase
  • OPEN: private phase, but chest is open to everyone
  • PUBLIC: public phase, everyone can loot
  • KILLER: public phase reserved to the killer
  • OWNER: public phase reserved to the owner
  • SHARE: public phase with mixed/restricted access rules

docs.title: Chest placement rules
docs.text: DeadChest never intentionally replaces solid blocks. If the exact death block is invalid, it searches for the nearest valid location.

docs.title: Overworld, Nether, End, custom worlds
docs.text: The same placement logic is used in all worlds.

docs.title: Death below the world
docs.text: DeadChest clamps to the lowest valid height for that world at the same horizontal position.

docs.title: Death above world max height
docs.text: DeadChest clamps to the highest valid height for that world at the same horizontal position.

docs.title: Death on non-placeable spots (doors, rails, torches, etc.)
docs.text: If the exact block cannot host a chest, DeadChest searches for the next valid free space.

docs.title: Water and lava deaths
docs.text:
DeadChest can generate in these environments if enabled:

  • generation.allow-on-water
  • generation.allow-on-lava

docs.title: Item handling
docs.text:
• Items with Curse of Vanishing are not stored.
  • Retrieval behavior depends on chest.recovery-mode.

docs.title: Protection and anti-grief behavior
docs.text: Depending on config, DeadChests are protected against unauthorized access and destruction. This includes owner checks and block protection logic.

docs.title: Performance model
docs.text: DeadChest is designed for active servers and focuses work on loaded areas/chunks to limit overhead.

docs.text:
Make sure you have downloaded the plugin first.

Installing DeadChest Pro?

docs.text:
1. Stop your server.
  2. Put DeadChest-X.X.X.jar into your plugins/ folder.

  • Verify plugins/DeadChest/ was generated.

If you encounter issues, check troubleshooting or ask on Discord.

docs.title: DeadChest - Troubleshooting
docs.text: This page covers common issues and quick fixes.

docs.title: Ghost/leftover hologram
docs.text:
Use:

/dc repair

If needed, use the force variant:

/dc repair force

You need admin permission (deadchest.admin) for repair commands.

docs.title: DeadChest not behaving as expected after update
docs.text:
1. Check your server version and Java version match plugin requirements.
  2. Run /dc reload after config changes.
  3. Verify config.yml was migrated correctly to schema version 2.
  4. Check startup logs for localization/config parsing warnings.

Note

Avoid deleting plugin data unless you know the impact on active chests.

docs.title: Commands not working
docs.text:
• Ensure command is /dc ...
  • Verify required permissions for your user/group
  • Check permissions.require-* settings in config

docs.title: WorldGuard behavior is incorrect
docs.text:
• Ensure integrations.worldguard.enabled: true
  • Verify region flags (dc-owner, dc-member, dc-guest)
  • Check integrations.worldguard.default-allow

docs.title: Need more help
docs.text:
• Share startup logs and relevant config sections when asking for support.
  • Join Discord support from the home page links.

docs.title: DeadChest - WorldGuard Integration
docs.text: DeadChest can use WorldGuard regions to control where a DeadChest may be generated.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• DeadChest installed and running
  • WorldGuard installed
  • Integration enabled in config.yml

docs.title: Enable integration
docs.text:
Set the following keys in config.yml:

integrations:
  worldguard:
    enabled: true
    default-allow: false
  • enabled: activates WorldGuard checks.
  • default-allow: fallback when no explicit DeadChest flag result applies.

docs.title: DeadChest WorldGuard flags
docs.text:
DeadChest registers these custom region flags:

Flag Meaning dc-owner Region owners can generate DeadChest in the region. dc-member Region members can generate DeadChest in the region. dc-guest Players who are neither owners nor members.

docs.title: How flags are evaluated
docs.text:
At the death location, each region uses the flag matching the player's role: dc-owner for owners, dc-member for other members, and dc-guest for everyone else. An owner uses only dc-owner, even if also listed as a member. Membership includes WorldGuard permission groups and inherited membership.

WorldGuard resolves parent flags and region-group restrictions. Among applicable decisions, higher-priority regions take precedence. At equal priority, a child can override its parent; conflicting unrelated regions resolve to deny. The global region supplies a fallback below local regions.

If no applicable flag is defined, DeadChest uses integrations.worldguard.default-allow. Flags for other roles do not affect the player.

docs.title: Example commands (WorldGuard)
docs.text:
Command syntax may vary slightly by WorldGuard version, but typically:

/rg flag <region> dc-owner allow
/rg flag <region> dc-member allow
/rg flag <region> dc-guest deny

docs.title: Verify integration
docs.text:
• Restart/reload server.
  • Check console logs for WorldGuard detection and flag behavior.
  • Test player deaths in and out of flagged regions.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
• If no custom flags appear, ensure WorldGuard is loaded before DeadChest check happens.
  • If behavior seems global, verify the exact region at death location.
  • If unsure, temporarily set default-allow: true to compare behavior.

docs.title: DeadChest Pro
docs.text:
DeadChest Pro includes the free edition's death chests, XP storage, holograms, protection settings and partial collection. It adds tools for finding active chests and returning eligible expired inventories to their owners.

Get DeadChest Pro on BuiltByBit Installation and migration

Install only the Pro JAR. It replaces the free plugin; no client mod, economy plugin or remote license activation is required.

docs.title: Pro features
docs.text:
Feature Where to start Browse active chests and preview their contents Chest menu Follow direction, distance and remaining time Live tracking Teleport near a chest with configurable restrictions Teleportation Inspect history and return eligible expired loot History and restoration Set permissions, languages and Pro options Configuration

New chest creation and direct inventory collection support automatic recovery after an interrupted transfer in both editions. Pro history restoration also supports this recovery. See recovery and backups for its scope.

docs.title: First steps
docs.text:
1. Install Pro or migrate from the free edition.
  2. Run /dc menu in game to browse your chests.
  3. Enable teleportation if you want to offer it to players. It is disabled by default.
  4. Give trusted staff the history and restoration permissions.

The core configuration and core commands still apply to Pro.

docs.title: Configuration and permissions
docs.text:
Pro stores its configuration and message files in plugins/Deadchest-Pro/:

File Purpose config.yml Core settings: chest lifetime, access, recovery, XP, holograms and integrations pro.yml Pro language, teleportation and history retention pro-<language>.yml Translated Pro messages, menu labels and feedback

Run /dc reload with deadchest.admin to reload core settings, Pro settings and messages. Reloading cancels pending teleport countdowns.

docs.title: Default pro.yml
docs.text:
language: en
teleport:
  enabled: false
  warmup-seconds: 5
  cooldown-seconds: 300
  cross-world: false
  denied-worlds: []
  feedback:
    action-bar: true
    titles: true
    particles: true
    sounds: true
history:
  retention-days: 30

See teleportation for the effect of each teleport option and history retention for cleanup rules.

docs.title: Languages and custom messages
docs.text:
Both core and Pro include these languages:

Code Language en English fr French de German es Spanish it Italian pl Polish pt-br Brazilian Portuguese zh-cn Simplified Chinese

Set localization.language in config.yml for core messages and language in pro.yml for Pro messages. Set both to the same code for a consistent interface. An unknown Pro language code falls back to English.

Edit the corresponding pro-<language>.yml, preserving message placeholders, then run /dc reload. Pro messages support & color codes. Existing customizations are kept; missing keys use the bundled translation for the selected language.

docs.title: Commands and permissions
docs.text:
Pro commands that open menus or act on a player are used in game. Square brackets denote optional arguments; angle brackets denote required arguments.

Command Permission Default /dc menu deadchest.pro.menu Everyone /dc track [latest/number/uuid] deadchest.pro.track Everyone /dc track off deadchest.pro.track Everyone /dc teleport [latest/number/uuid] deadchest.pro.teleport Operators /dc history <player> [page] deadchest.pro.history Operators /dc restore [player] deadchest.pro.restore and deadchest.pro.history for the history menu Operators /dc restore <chest-uuid> deadchest.pro.restore Operators /dc reload deadchest.admin Operators

Revoke deadchest.pro.menu or deadchest.pro.track through your permission manager if those features should be restricted. Grant teleportation separately; menu access does not grant permission to teleport. Core chest access rules still apply.

All core commands and permissions remain available.

docs.title: Browse a player's history
docs.text:
Run /dc history <player> [page] in game with deadchest.pro.history. The player argument accepts a name or player UUID. Select an eligible expired entry to inspect its remaining items and XP before deciding whether to return them.

/dc restore <player> opens that player's history. Without an argument, /dc restore opens your own. Grant both deadchest.pro.history and deadchest.pro.restore to staff who need the full selection and confirmation flow.

docs.title: Return expired contents
docs.text:
1. Open the owner's history and select an eligible expired chest.
  2. Inspect the contents in the restoration preview.
  3. Click the explicit confirmation button.
  4. Read the delivery message. Items and XP go to the original owner, not the administrator.

A full chest UUID can also be supplied to /dc restore <chest-uuid> to open the confirmation preview directly. It does not bypass eligibility or permission checks.

Only expired chests whose contents were not dropped into the world are eligible. Collected, deleted, exploded, given-back or already restored contents cannot be restored through this feature.

If a player collected part of a chest before expiration, only the unclaimed remainder is eligible. Previously collected XP is not awarded again.

docs.title: Pending deliveries
docs.text:
If the owner is offline or lacks enough inventory space for the complete return, delivery remains pending. It is retried on join and when an inventory is closed. Ask the owner to free enough space and close the inventory.

Unlike normal partial chest collection, history restoration waits until the whole remaining inventory fits. It does not drop overflow items on the ground. Confirmation queues a single return; staff should not manually duplicate it.

docs.title: Retention
docs.text:
history.retention-days in pro.yml defaults to 30, with a minimum of one day. Pending deliveries and records requiring review are not removed by retention cleanup.

Existing active chests are imported when Pro is installed. Earlier events cannot be reconstructed. History is stored in pro-history.db, separately from data.db.

docs.title: Recovery and backups
docs.text:
New chest creation, direct inventory collection and Pro history restoration use persisted transfer records and player receipts to resume after a server interruption when the affected player returns. A dead player must first respawn. Ground drops and the separate /dc giveback delivery path do not use this mechanism.

Back up and restore worlds, player data and the complete plugin data folder together while the server is stopped. Do not remove transfer tags or manually reset database states: they prevent duplicate deliveries.

Older ambiguous operations without a verifiable receipt can remain in REVIEW. These are not automatically retried. Preserve the logs and a complete backup, compare the owner's inventory, XP and active chests, and contact support before attempting a manual correction. Do not reset a review record to pending or return its full contents without establishing what the player has already received.

docs.title: New installation
docs.text:
Download the Pro distribution from the official DeadChest Pro page on BuiltByBit.

  1. Stop the server.
  2. Put dead-chest-pro-<version>.jar in plugins/. Use the complete distribution JAR.
  3. Start the server and check that Deadchest-Pro enables without errors.
  4. Configure core behavior in plugins/Deadchest-Pro/config.yml and Pro features in plugins/Deadchest-Pro/pro.yml.
  5. Set permissions and languages, then run /dc reload.

Pro uses the SQLite driver supplied by the server, like the free edition. No additional SQLite JAR needs to be installed. Use the Java version required by your server. Pro supports Spigot/Paper from Minecraft 1.13 onward and Folia.

Do not install the free and Pro JARs together. Pro refuses to enable when the free DeadChest plugin is also loaded. Use a full server restart when changing editions.

docs.title: Upgrade from the free edition
docs.text:
1. Stop the server. Back up its worlds, player data, free JAR and complete DeadChest data folder together. Keep the same Minecraft version during migration.
  2. Remove the free JAR and install the Pro JAR.
  3. Copy the complete contents of the free data folder into plugins/Deadchest-Pro/. Use the actual source folder name on your server. Do not overwrite an existing Pro installation.
  4. Start a test copy first. Check startup logs, /dc list, chest locations, item collection and XP before reopening the production server.
  5. Configure pro.yml and grant Pro permissions.

Copying the whole folder preserves configuration, translations, existing chests, pending operations and any older migration files. Keep the original backup intact.

Existing active chests are imported into Pro history. Events that happened before Pro was installed cannot be reconstructed.

docs.title: Updating Pro
docs.text: Stop the server, make a complete backup and replace the Pro JAR with the new distribution. Keep the data folder. Start the server and check the logs. Existing custom messages are preserved; missing keys use the bundled translation.

docs.title: Returning to the free edition
docs.text:
Complete pending Pro restorations and resolve any records requiring review before switching editions. The free edition cannot process the Pro restoration queue.

To return to the exact pre-migration state, stop the server and restore the worlds, player data and free plugin folder from the same backup, then replace the Pro JAR with the free JAR. Restoring only an old chest database while keeping current player inventories can duplicate previously collected items.

Do not downgrade worlds or items to an older Minecraft version as part of this process.

docs.title: Chest menu
docs.text:
Run /dc menu in game. The menu lists your active chests, newest first, with pages when needed. Entries show a readable death number and date, location, remaining time, item count and XP.

Select a chest to preview its contents without removing anything. The interface also offers tracking and teleportation, subject to their permissions and settings. Right-click previews of a chest in the world respect the core access rules, including private/public access and the recovery permission when required.

Opening a preview does not collect items or pause the expiration timer. Normal collection still happens at the chest. With inventory recovery enabled, one click takes what fits and leaves the remainder for another click.

Permission: deadchest.pro.menu, granted to everyone by default.

docs.title: Live tracking
docs.text:
/dc track
/dc track 2
/dc track off

Without an argument, tracking selects your latest chest. The live display shows direction, distance and remaining time. For a chest in another world, it tells you which world to visit. /dc track off stops the guidance.

Permission: deadchest.pro.track, granted to everyone by default.

docs.title: Selecting a chest
docs.text:
Both /dc track and /dc teleport accept latest, a number from the current menu order, or a full chest UUID. 1 is the newest chest. Numbers can change when chests are created or collected; they are not permanent identifiers.

Menu buttons remain linked to the specific chest displayed. Players can use the menus and numbered commands without copying UUIDs.

docs.title: Teleportation
docs.text: Teleportation returns a player near their chest after a countdown. It is disabled by default and requires deadchest.pro.teleport.

docs.title: Enable teleportation
docs.text:
In plugins/Deadchest-Pro/pro.yml:

teleport:
  enabled: true
  warmup-seconds: 5
  cooldown-seconds: 300
  cross-world: false
  denied-worlds: []
  feedback:
    action-bar: true
    titles: true
    particles: true
    sounds: true

Grant deadchest.pro.teleport to the desired players or groups using your permission manager, then run /dc reload. Operators have this permission by default, but the feature must still be enabled in the configuration.

Players can use /dc teleport, /dc teleport 2, or the button in a chest preview. Selection follows the same rules as tracking.

docs.title: Countdown and cooldown
docs.text:
The default warmup lasts five seconds. Movement, damage, death, disconnection, another teleport or a configuration reload can cancel a pending teleport. Repeating the command during the countdown does not restart it.

The 300-second cooldown starts only after a successful teleport. Failed or cancelled attempts do not start it. A value of 0 disables the corresponding delay.

The action bar, countdown and arrival titles, particles and sounds can be disabled separately. Teleport feedback takes priority over tracking while active.

docs.title: Worlds and safe destinations
docs.text:
Cross-world travel is disabled by default. Set cross-world: true to allow it. denied-worlds uses exact world names and applies to both departure and destination.

The plugin checks nearby footing, space for the player, hazards and the world border before teleporting. It searches within the chest's chunk, up to four blocks horizontally and from three blocks below to four above the chest. A chest near a chunk boundary can have no acceptable destination in that area.

docs.title: When a teleport is refused
docs.text:
Messages distinguish disabled teleportation, missing permission, cooldown, blocked or unavailable worlds, disabled cross-world travel, unavailable chests, access restrictions, dead players, vehicles and a lack of safe footing.

Check the reported reason first. If the destination is unsafe, approach normally or make the nearby area safe. Another plugin or the server can also reject the teleport; its exact reason may not be available to DeadChest.
